Merkle Tree Certificates replace a chain of signatures with an inclusion proof in a log [S1]. The proof grows with the log only as $O(\log n)$ hashes.

> "An inclusion proof for a certificate consists of the hash of each sibling node along the path from the certificate to the treehead." [S4]

The pack does not say how revocation works.
